recognize_zh: 新亞甲藍超活體染色下，部分紅血球內布滿均勻細小、平均分布的藍色點狀包涵體，外觀像高爾夫球表面（golf ball），即 HbH 包涵體；另有少數細胞內是粗大不規則的網狀藍色物質，屬網狀紅血球，要區分開來。
features: Many red cells with numerous fine, evenly distributed blue-green stippled inclusions (golf-ball appearance)
Inclusions are uniform in size and diffusely distributed over the whole cell
Scattered cells with coarser, irregular dark blue reticular or granular precipitates consistent with reticulocytes
Red cells appear small with variation in size
Supravital staining with pale blue background; no nucleated cells in this field
describe_en: Supravital new methylene blue preparation of peripheral blood shows numerous red cells containing multiple fine, uniform, evenly distributed blue inclusions imparting a golf-ball appearance, characteristic of precipitated hemoglobin H (beta-4 tetramers). Separate cells contain coarser, irregular dark blue reticular material, consistent with reticulocytes. Red cells appear small and variable in size. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin H disease; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC and alpha-globin gene analysis is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reticulocytes show coarse, irregular, filamentous or clumped blue reticulum rather than fine evenly spaced golf-ball dots.
Heinz bodies are one to a few larger inclusions attached to the membrane periphery, not numerous fine uniform dots.
Alpha-thalassemia trait shows only rare or no HbH inclusions after prolonged incubation, compared with frequent inclusions in HbH disease.
Basophilic stippling is seen on Romanowsky-stained smears and represents ribosomal RNA, not a supravital hemoglobin precipitate.
